BiblicalUsage: Zeresh is Haman's wife, and she is the voice behind his worst idea. When Haman comes home boasting, she and his friends tell him to build the gallows for Mordecai — and when the king's favour turns, she is the one who tells him his fall is certain. Her full story lives on her People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Zeresh is a warning about the counsel we keep. The people closest to us can push us toward the gallows we build for others, and the gallows, in the end, are ours.
